source.report: Digital Progress and Trends Report 2025: Strengthening AI Foundations

editorial_policy: Only original printed numerical panel labels transcribed from PDF pages 83 and 85, cross-checked visually; not counts of underlying records. Ratios and time periods are not interchangeable. Numeric panels within Figures 4.2 and 4.3 separately counted; neither entire report's graphics nor underlying studies independently validated. World Bank Figure 2.2 was transcribed as four exact nine-year orbit-class series from printed labels on PDF page 50; categories are not proxies for bandwidth, coverage or observed 2026 satellites.
